name: Look-and-feel Before Parent
description: Run once per CustomLookAndFeel::get call site (refactor.units 'CustomLookAndFeel::get' Source): does it read the theme before its component has a parent or a look-and-feel of its own?

fields.name: matchLine
fields.description: the source line holding the CustomLookAndFeel::get call

fields.name: function
fields.description: the function the call sits in, or none for a member initializer

fields.name: functionBody
fields.description: the enclosing function with line numbers, or the lines around a member initializer

fields.name: owner
fields.description: the class that owns the function

fields.name: reach
fields.description: whether constructing the owner runs the call, measured from the code: yes with the direct call chain, or no with the reason (inside a lambda, no constructor calls it)

fields.name: constructorCalls
fields.description: every name the owner's constructors call directly, outside any lambda

fields.name: constructors
fields.description: the owner's constructors with line numbers, or none

fields.name: file
fields.description: the file the call is in

fields.name: line
fields.description: the line the call is on

globalState.rule: CustomLookAndFeel::get is a static_cast of the component's inherited look-and-feel, so calling it on a component that has no parent and no look-and-feel of its own is undefined. Read the theme in paint, resized or a user-driven handler, not in a constructor - and resized only counts as safe when the constructor does not itself call setSize, setBounds or setBoundsRelative, because JUCE runs resized synchronously inside those calls. Pop-up and window roots that take a CustomLookAndFeel& and NodeCanvas set their look-and-feel explicitly.
globalState.matchLine: the source line holding the CustomLookAndFeel::get call
globalState.function: the function the call sits in, or none for a member initializer
globalState.functionBody: the enclosing function with line numbers
globalState.owner: the class that owns the function
globalState.constructors: the owner's constructors with line numbers
globalState.reach: whether constructing the owner runs the call: yes with how, or no with why
globalState.constructorCalls: every name the owner's constructors call directly, outside any lambda

construction.label: Does a constructor run the call?

config.statement: state.reach starts with yes: constructing state.owner runs the CustomLookAndFeel::get call in state.matchLine.

state.reach only follows direct calls, so it misses one case: JUCE runs resized synchronously inside setSize, setBounds and setBoundsRelative. This statement is about that case alone: state.function is resized, and the list in state.constructorCalls contains setSize, setBounds or setBoundsRelative.

ownLookAndFeel.label: Does the constructor set a look-and-feel?

config.statement: state.constructors calls setLookAndFeel, so the component being constructed has a look-and-feel of its own before the CustomLookAndFeel::get call in state.matchLine runs.

otherComponent.label: Is the call given another component?

config.statement: The component passed to CustomLookAndFeel::get in state.matchLine is not the one being constructed (not *this) but another component that was built earlier and already sits inside the editor.

config.description: The call runs after construction, once the component is inside the editor.
The call runs during construction, but its component already has a look-and-feel.
The call reads the theme before its component has a parent or a look-and-feel of its own.
config.directive: {{id}} in {{owner}} calls CustomLookAndFeel::get during construction, before the component has a parent or a look-and-feel of its own. Move the read into paint, resized or a user-driven handler, or set the look-and-feel explicitly in the constructor first.
